description: Angular component for rendering Markdown content with dynamic component creation, syntax highlighting, and fallback handling.

classes.name: TbMarkdownComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rendering Markdown with support for syntax highlighting, custom styles, and fallback options.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, triggers re-rendering of Markdown content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes Markdown string, compiles HTML, applies styles, and dynamically creates component for rendering.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors during rendering, optionally falls back to plain Markdown.

methods.name: plainMarkdown
methods.description: Renders Markdown as plain HTML with inline styles if needed.

methods.name: handlePlugins
methods.description: Applies syntax highlighting plugins like line numbers.

methods.name: setPluginClass
methods.description: Adds plugin classes to <pre> elements for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: handleImages
methods.description: Waits for images to load before signaling completion.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes template string by replacing special characters.
